test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can complete a piece of work alone in 10 days and B can complete the same piece of work alone in 15 days. Working together, A, B and C can complete this work in 4(1)/(2); days. If B does not work, while A and C work on alternate days, starting with C, then in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A completes a piece of work in 10 days

B completes same work in 15 days

A B and C can completes same work in 4 1/2 days 

A and C works on alternate days 

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total work/No. of days 

**Calculation:**

Let us assume total work to be done is 90 [L.C.M (10, 15, 4 1/2) = 90] 

Now, as A completes work in 10 days 

Efficiency of A = 90/10 = 9 

B takes 15 days to complete the work </
